evidence.decision: Orders meaningful first play, playable teaching, each platform's default input and inclusive cues, and keeps the documented 44 pt touch-size conflict conservative; still accurate after the macOS touch addition, because the procedure maps core actions to each platform's normal input first.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a revised first-play sequence and a per-platform action/display contract or implementation within the game engine and identity.
evidence.transformation: The puzzle port ships a playable world, teaches tile manipulation in context and supports touch and undo instead of waiting for all downloads and requiring a controller; unchanged and still consistent with the guide.
evidence.verification: Fails unnecessary play gates, incomplete input for an advertised platform and essential single-sense cues; measured downloads and controller tests are not invented.
evidence.applicability: Keeps the watchOS controller exception, supported orientations and safe-area/readability limits; the guide's per-platform input table, now including touch as an additional macOS input, is the reference the procedure points to. Social, progress and purchase services stay conditional.
evidence.handoffs: Routes control mapping, player accommodations and chosen social play to Game controls, Accessibility and Game Center.
evidence.distinctiveness: First-install playability, platform action mapping and redundant critical cues drive real game-production changes.
